Include health observations, recovery instructions, a README and reflection on errors caught. Unexecuted checks or an undeployed prototype cannot be described as a production release.

Reference application: A study-task application is deployed to a test environment, tested through creation and reload, and checked with two users for isolation. A release report links the exact commit, test outputs, deployment, README and rollback procedure. An unresolved security failure blocks approval even if the UI works.

rubric.criterion: Explain and correctly apply: Deliver and explain an AI-assisted application with independently checkable release evidence.
anchors: No relevant explanation
Repeats terms without applying them
Partly correct with a material conceptual error
Correct explanation applied to the case
Correct application plus a justified boundary or counterexample

rubric.criterion: Deliver the requested work: Submit requirements, architecture decisions, implementation, repository and Git history, working UI, applicable backend/data, tests, security checks, deployment, E2E evidence, README and a reflection distinguishing agent output from your verification.
anchors: No artifact
Unrelated artifact
Partially completed or not inspectable
Complete artifact with traceable inputs and output
Complete reproducible artifact with clear reasoning and documented revisions

rubric.criterion: Check the lesson-specific failure illustrated here: A production-oriented capstone can claim deployment or security verification without executing those checks.
anchors: No check
Unsupported claim that it works
A check is described but its outcome is not recorded
A relevant check was executed and its actual outcome recorded
Normal and boundary checks recorded with limitations and a root-cause explanation

rubric.criterion: Identify your contribution, sources, AI assistance, synthetic inputs and unexecuted work accurately; use only authorized data and test systems.
anchors: Fabricated evidence or unauthorized activity
Missing provenance
Incomplete disclosure or ambiguous execution claims
Accurate provenance and disclosure with no unresolved authorization issue
Accurate provenance plus a clear audit trail and appropriate privacy minimization
